IndexedDB is an asynchronous, transactional browser database for structured data. It organizes records into
object stores and supports indexes and version upgrades.

Interview question: Why use IndexedDB rather than localStorage for many records?

Answer: It supports asynchronous structured storage, transactions and indexes instead of synchronous
string-only key/value access.
